title: Iridium configuration
description: Configuration file for Iridium servers and clients. Every section and setting is optional; missing settings take their defaults.

$schema.description: Editor hint pointing at this schema. Ignored by the loader.

server.description: Where an Iridium proxy server listens and what it serves.

port.description: TCP port to listen on. 0 picks a free port.

basePath.description: URL path prefix the server is mounted under.

wispPath.description: URL path of the Wisp WebSocket endpoint.

staticDir.description: Directory of static client files to serve.

transport.description: How connections are opened. Read by createTransport() in @iridium-group/transport.

type.description: direct: TCP/TLS from Node. wisp: through a Wisp server. memory: in-process, for tests.

url.description: ws:// or wss:// URL of the Wisp server. Required when type is "wisp".

security.description: Address policy for direct connections. Matches AddressPolicy in @iridium-group/transport.

blockPrivateAddresses.description: Reject targets that resolve to private or special-purpose addresses.

allowedPorts.description: When set, only these ports are accepted.

format.description: pretty for humans, json for one JSON object per line.
